I'm **Alfredo Ramirez Diaz**, a full-stack developer living in Massachusetts, near Boston.

I studied **Computer Engineering at UNITEC** in Honduras. My first serious work was in PHP with Yii2's MVC; later I spent years building business systems on **Frappe and ERPNext** — that's where [Ren POS](/projects), my restaurant point of sale, comes from.

Over time I kept writing the same plumbing again and again: models, forms, permissions, APIs, deployment. So I started **[Loopar](https://loopar.build)** — an open-source meta-framework where you define an entity once and get the database, the REST API, the forms and the views. This site is itself a Loopar app.

## What drives me

I'm motivated by automation and by tools that give people back their time. I also want to show other developers from Honduras, and from anywhere with fewer opportunities, that you can build serious software from wherever you start.

## Outside the code

I film planes, birds and New England landscapes under **Ardframes** — the same patience it takes to wait for the right light helps with hard bugs.
